description: This dataset contains emissions inventory data, specifically focusing on differences in various emission sectors between 2010 and 2015. It comprises twelve NetCDF files, each representing a distinct source category such as agriculture, energy, industry, and transportation. The file names serve as identifiers containing temporal resolution at the year level, while the associated URLs provide direct access to the climate-related resources. File sizes range from a few hundred bytes to over thirty thousand, reflecting the varying data density across sectors. Researchers can utilize this dataset to analyze trends in anthropogenic emissions, supporting climate modeling and environmental policy assessments by providing detailed, sector-specific emission changes over the specified period.
